On 2016-12-29, the customer reported an unauthorized online transaction of $131.30 (ID 3583368) that occurred at 03:27:44. The episode includes a total of four online transactions on 2016-12-29 between 00:53:52 and 03:27:44, resulting in a total exposure of $235.66. The flagged transaction was conducted using a new device profile identified as SM-G610F Build/NRD90M |  | chrome 66.0 for android |. Graph analysis reveals this specific device profile is rare but was used on two other cards (C03938-K1, C05595-K1) belonging to different customers on 2016-12-28. The use of a rare, fully specified device across multiple unrelated accounts indicates a likely fraud ring. The activity fits the card_not_present_new_device pattern. Consequently, the bank has closed the case as fraud, blocked the card, and initiated monitoring on the connected cards.
